projects.title: OPPY
projects.category: AI Opportunity Discovery Platform · Live · Deployed
projects.description: An AI-powered opportunity discovery platform that helps students and early-career users discover, personalize, save and track opportunities like internships, jobs, hackathons, fellowships, events, grants and scholarships.
projects.overview: OPPY discovers real opportunities from across the web and matches them to what users are looking for. It is built for students and early-career users, combining opportunity aggregation, AI-powered natural-language and voice search, personalized recommendations, saving and application tracking in one platform.
features: Browse and discover opportunities with category, location, remote, skill/interest, experience and search filters
AI-powered natural-language search and voice input using Sarvam AI
Personalized "Recommended for you" opportunities based on user interests and preferences
Aggregates internships, jobs, hackathons, fellowships, events, grants and scholarships
Save opportunities to a personal Saved list
Application tracking with statuses including Interested, Applied, Interview, Offer and more
Similar opportunities and recently viewed history
Automated opportunity ingestion, normalization, deduplication, quality filtering and lifecycle handling
Public opportunity discovery with authentication required for saving, tracking, personalization, profile, resume and dashboard features
